_comment: Manual resolutions for GA state campaign finance matching. Keys are the candidate id (or memberId) from races.json. Set filerEntityId to pin a filing, or noFiling:true to suppress the section. Regenerate the review queue with scripts/report_ga_finance_matches.py.

challenger-rick-jackson-gov-2026._note: Rick = Richard L. Jackson (Jackson for Governor, Inc.); the other Jackson in this race is Derrick L.

ga-house-108-2026-r-1._note: Previously (wrongly) marked noFiling. Filer 104068 'Davila, Elvia' is House 108 / REP, committee 'Elvia and Friends', $1,000 raised. The ballot name is the compound 'Davila-Pelayo' and candidateLastName() takes only the last token ('Pelayo'), so the seat+surname matcher could not join them. Same failure mode as ga-senate-12-2026-d-3.

ga-house-167-2026-d-2._note: Previously (wrongly) marked noFiling. Filer 106455 'Hicks Jr, Nathaniel' is House 167 / DEM with $0 raised — a real filing reporting zero, which is not the same claim as no filing.

ga-senate-12-2026-d-3._note: Incumbent Sen. Freddie Powell SIMS (Dist 12); races.json lists her maiden/middle name 'Freddie Powell' while her committee files as 'Freddie Sims', so the seat+surname matcher couldn't join them and this was previously (wrongly) marked noFiling. Filer 101051 is her active 2026 Senate-12 committee ($104K raised).

ga-senate-29-2026-d-1._note: Previously (wrongly) marked noFiling. Filer 105966 'Lowe, Jeffrey C.' is Senate 29 / DEM with $0 raised — a real filing reporting zero. The ballot name 'Jeff' vs the filing's 'Jeffrey' is why the matcher missed it.
